topics.name: Missions
pages: A mission won brings gold, fame, experience and things found on the field.
After a mission you can pay a visit to a general you have spoken with.
If your warrior's health falls to nothing during a mission, the mission is lost.
Experience and things picked up in a lost mission are gone with it.
A lost mission can also cost you one of the things you are wearing.

topics.name: Visiting
pages: Generals you finish a mission with, or meet on the field, can be visited once the mission is over.
You will find Visiting in the main menu, but only once a mission has been won.
A visit can bring you a skill, a thing, gold, fame, or even a point to your stats!

topics.name: Blacksmith
pages: The smith buys and sells things.
He can also charm a thing by combining it with certain others.
Try putting different things together at the smith's to discover new ones.
Online you can buy, sell or give things to other players, and keep your gold on the server.
Remember that a tax is taken on every thing sold or given to another player.
Changed your mind about a sale? Live > Trade > Cancel Sale takes the thing back.

topics.name: Skills
pages: The only way to learn a skill, or improve one, is a visit to a warrior or general.
Open Management > Skill in the game menu before a mission to swap the skills you carry.
A skill's level rises only through a visit to a general.

topics.name: Gear
pages: Everything you can wear, weapons and armour alike, is called gear.
Before a mission starts you can put on your gear under Management > Gear in the game menu.
A piece of gear is plain, special or rare. Some pieces are very hard to come by.
Every piece of gear wears out after so much use.
Only the smith can charm a piece of gear.

topics.name: Experience
pages: Finishing a mission brings gold, fame, experience and things.
Gather enough experience from missions and your level goes up.
Your warrior rises a level each time his experience reaches the next mark.
Every new level gives you three points to spend as you see fit.
The points go into attack, defence, health or spirit.
Choose with care: a point once spent cannot be taken back.

topics.name: Saving
pages: Every step you take is saved on its own.
A mission can be saved after a stage is cleared, but if the mission is lost, that save is lost too.
The Live entry of the game menu puts your warrior on the server and fetches him back.
Try your warrior in online missions. He is ranked against other players without you lifting a finger.
Your standing is shown in the multiplayer game.
Use Load User Data to load a warrior saved on this device.
Connecting to Live adds your saved experience and fame on its own.

topics.name: Control
pages: Attack: 5 or OK. Move: 2, 4, 6, 8 or the arrows. Skills: 1, 3, 7, 9, 0. Things: * and #.
Only the 0 key can hold the Aerial Attack skill.
